def fill_with_adjacent_rule(grid, bg_val=1):
    """
    Fill between consecutive markers, with special rule for adjacent markers.
    Adjacent markers at c, c+1 cause: marker at c becomes filled, marker at c+2 appears.
    """
    result = [[v for v in row] for row in grid]
    
    marker_vals = set(v for row in grid for v in row if v != bg_val)
    
    # Keep iterating until no more fills
    while True:
        changed = False
        did_fill = False
        did_special = False
        
        # Horizontal fills
        for r in range(len(result)):
            marker_cols = [c for c, v in enumerate(result[r]) if v in marker_vals]
            for i in range(len(marker_cols) - 1):
                c1, c2 = marker_cols[i], marker_cols[i+1]
                gap = c2 - c1 - 1
                
                if gap == 0:  # Adjacent markers
                    # Special rule: c1 becomes filled, c1+2 becomes new marker
                    if 0 <= c1 + 2 < len(result[0]):
                        result[r][c1] = 9  # Fill c1
                        result[r][c1 + 2] = 1  # New marker at c1+2
                        did_special = True
                        changed = True
                elif gap > 0:  # Non-adjacent markers
                    # Normal fill: fill gap, keep markers
                    for c in range(c1 + 1, c2):
                        if result[r][c] == bg_val:
                            result[r][c] = 9
                            did_fill = True
                            changed = True
        
        # Vertical fills
        for c in range(len(grid[0])):
            marker_rows = [r for r in range(len(result)) if result[r][c] in marker_vals]
            for i in range(len(marker_rows) - 1):
                r1, r2 = marker_rows[i], marker_rows[i+1]
                gap = r2 - r1 - 1

                        result[r1 + 2][c] = 1
                        did_special = True
                        changed = True

                    for r in range(r1 + 1, r2):
                        if result[r][c] == bg_val:
                            result[r][c] = 9
                            did_fill = True
